title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of three Hundred thousand Pesos for Propaganda or Publicity for Philippine Cigars and Other Tobacco Products in the United states and Other Countries.

text.en:
The sum of three hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any general funds of the
Insular Government not otherwise appropriated, for disbursement for propaganda or publicity for Philippine
cigars and other tobacco products in the United States and other countries. This propaganda or publicity
campaign shall be under the control and direction of the Tobacco Board created by Act Numbered Thirty-one
hundred and seventy-nine.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 9, 1927.
